MAX(TRIM(A.ATOB_REMARK)) AS ATOB_REMARK, MAX(TRIM(A.IMAGE_KEY)) AS IMAGE_KEY, A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.KEP_USER_ID)) AS KEP_USER_NAME, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX(A.REG_ITEM_NO) AS REG_ITEM_NO, MAX(A.CONTRACT_NO) AS CONTRACT_NO, MAX(A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CONTRACT_SEQ, MAX((SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R'))) AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, MAX(NVL(TRIM(A.BTOA_REMARK),'')) AS BTOA_REMARK, MAX(A.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) AS AGENT_OPEN_FLAG, MAX(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE) AS STOA_LIST_PRICE, MAX(A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_CODE, MAX(B.LEAD_TIME) AS LEAD_TIME, MAX(A.LOAD_USER_ID) AS LOAD_USER_ID, MAX(A.ATOB_DATE) AS ATOB_DATE, MAX(A.CMS_CATEG_ID) AS CMS_CATEG_ID, MAX(A.CMS_CATLG_ID) AS CMS_CATLG_ID, MAX(A.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE, MAX(A.IMPORT_FLAG) AS IMPORT_FLAG, MAX(NVL(A.WAREHOUSE_CODE,'')) AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, MAX(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE, MAX(A.ITEM_GROUP) AS ITEM_GROUP , MAX(A.ITEM_DETAIL_DESC) AS ITEM_DETAIL_DESC , MAX(DECODE(A.ITEM_TYPE,'T','계약요청품목','O','일회성품목','N','미분류')) AS ITEM_TYPE_TEXT , MAX(A.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE , MAX(NVL(A.GREEN_FLAG,'N')) AS GREEN_FLAG , MAX(A.ITEM_GUBUN) AS ITEM_GUBUN , MAX(SUBSTR(A.REG_ITEM_NO,0,10)) AS REG_ITEM_NO2 ,MAX((SELECT ITEM_NO FROM ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE CQDT.BUYER = A.BUYER AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND MAX(DECODE(NVL(DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_YN),'N')||A.MSDS_STATUS,'YC','MSDS제출','YT','MSDS검토','YA','MSDS승인')) AS MSDS_TYPE_TEXT , MAX(REQ_PRICE_TYPE) AS REQ_PRICE_TYPE , DECODE(MAX(A.RFQ_IMG_TYPE), 'M', MAX(A.IMGFILE_DIR), MAX(B.IMGFILE_DIR)) AS IMGFILE_DIR , DECODE(MAX(A.RFQ_IMG_TYPE), 'M', MAX(A.IMGFILE_NAME), MAX(B.IMGFILE_NAME)) AS IMGFILE_NAME , MAX(A.SELL_CLOSE_DATE) AS SELL_CLOSE_DATE , MAX(A.BUY_CLOSE_DATE) AS BUY_CLOSE_DATE , MAX(B.MIN_ORDER_QTY) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY , MAX(B.PUR_UNIT_QTY) AS PUR_UNIT_QTY , NVL(MAX(A.BUYER_MSDS_YN),'N') AS BUYER_MSDS_YN , MAX(A.MAKER_PART_NO) AS MAKER_PART_NO FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT COD3.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.TYPE = 'TCFM' AND COD3.CODE1 = #{st_com_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') AND A.SO_CA_FLAG='SO'
AND A.ATOB_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.BTOA_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION=B.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE <> 0 AND A.CONFIRM_DATE IS NULL AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('GA','GR') AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'O' AND NVL(A.MSDS_STATUS,'N') <> 'R'
AND A.QUOTATION_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_quotation_no} || '%'
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.BTOA_USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_btoa_user_name} || '%'
AND DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'GR','결재반려',DECODE(NVL(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE,0),0,(CASE WHEN NVL(DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_YN),'N')= 'N' OR MSDS_STATUS NOT IN ('C', 'T') THEN '합의대상 (MSDS 미승인 제외)' ELSE '합의대상' END), 'Nego합의대상')) LIKE #{st_sourcing_status} ||'%'
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_select}
AND (A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' )
AND A.BTOA_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}
AND DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_YN) = 'Y' AND DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_STATUS) = 'C'
AND DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_YN) = 'Y' AND DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_STATUS) = 'T'
AND DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_YN) = 'Y' AND DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', 'N', 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_STATUS) = 'A'
GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION ) X WHERE 1=1
AND UPPER(X.BTOA_USER_DEPT) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_btoa_user_dept_name}||'%')
ORDER BY X.ATOB_DATE DESC
) Y ) Z

MERGE INTO ICOMBYIT A /*updateNsApproval2Multi*/ USING (SELECT B.BUYER , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.REG_ITEM_NO , B.LOAD_USER_ID , B.DESCRIPTION , B.SPECIFICATION , B.UNIT_MEASURE , C.LEAD_TIME , B.MAKER_NAME , B.CMS_CATEG_ID , B.CMS_CATLG_ID , B.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE , B.ITEM_GROUP , B.ITEM_DETAIL_DESC , B.IMAGE_KEY , B.IMGFILE_NAME , B.IMGFILE_DIR FROM KEPRQDT B, KEPQTDT C WHERE B.BUYER = #{KEY_2} AND B.GW_NO = #{KEY_1} AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO = C.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = C.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = C.REVISION AND C.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND C.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' ) B ON ( A.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D') AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG=DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'T', 'T', DECODE(SUBSTR(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7),'NO_CODE','G','N') ), /* N (단, NO_CODE 일 경우 : G) */ A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_USER_ID = B.LOAD_USER_ID, A.CHANGE_USER_TEL = (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=B.LOAD_USER_ID), A.CHANGE_USER_NAME = (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=B.LOAD_USER_ID), A.CHANGE_USER_DEPT = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=B.LOAD_USER_ID), A.DESCRIPTION_LOC = DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S',B.DESCRIPTION,A.DESCRIPTION_LOC), A.SPECIFICATION = DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.SPECIFICATION,A.SPECIFICATION), A.UNIT_MEASURE = DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.UNIT_MEASURE,A.UNIT_MEASURE), A.DELIVERY_LT = DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.LEAD_TIME, A.DELIVERY_LT), A.MAKER_NAME = DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.MAKER_NAME, A.MAKER_NAME), A.PURCHASER_ID = B.LOAD_USER_ID, A.PURCHASER_NAME = (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=B.LOAD_USER_ID), A.CMS_CATEG_ID=DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.CMS_CATEG_ID,A.CMS_CATEG_ID), A.CMS_CATLG_ID=DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.CMS_CATLG_ID,A.CMS_CATLG_ID), A.PREV_DEAL_PRICE=DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE,A.PREV_DEAL_PRICE), A.ITEM_GROUP=DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', B.ITEM_GROUP,A.ITEM_GROUP), A.STATUS='R' , A.ITEM_DETAIL_DESC = B.ITEM_DETAIL_DESC , A.IMAGE_KEY = B.IMAGE_KEY , A.IMGFILE_NAME = B.IMGFILE_NAME , A.IMGFILE_DIR = B.IMGFILE_DIR

MERGE INTO ICOMCQDT A /*updateNsApproval3Multi*/ USING ( SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQDT.CONTRACT_NO , RQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , RQDT.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE , RQDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , QTDT.STOA_LIST_PRICE , BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG , RQDT.REG_ITEM_NO , RQDT.PROCESS_TYPE , RQDT.IMPORT_FLAG , RQDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE , RQDT.DESCRIPTION , RQDT.SPECIFICATION , RQDT.MAKER_NAME , RQDT.UNIT_MEASURE , RQDT.ORIGIN_CODE , QTDT.AGENT , RQDT.SELL_CLOSE_DATE , RQDT.BUY_CLOSE_DATE , QTDT.MIN_ORDER_QTY , QTDT.PUR_UNIT_QTY FROM KEPRQDT RQDT, KEPQTDT QTDT, ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE RQDT.BUYER=#{KEY_2} AND RQDT.GW_NO=#{KEY_1} AND RQDT.BUYER = QTDT.BUYER AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = QTDT.QUOTATION_NO AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND RQDT.REVISION = QTDT.REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND BYIT.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = RQDT.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) B ON ( A.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{KEY_2} AND STATUS <> 'D') AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND (A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE IN (SELECT BL.COMORG_CODE FROM BYCAORGL BL, ICOMCMPY CP WHERE BL.P_COMORG_CODE IN (SELECT P_COMORG_CODE FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = #{KEY_2}) AND BL.COMORG_CODE = CP.COM_CODE AND CP.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = 'ALL') OR A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE=B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE ) ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.TARGET_PRICE = B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , A.UNIT_PRICE = B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , A.LIST_PRICE = B.STOA_LIST_PRICE , A.SELLER_ITEM_NO=DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'S',B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,A.SELLER_ITEM_NO) , A.AGENT = (CASE WHEN B.PROCESS_TYPE = '1' OR B.PROCESS_TYPE = '3' THEN B.WAREHOUSE_CODE WHEN B.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' OR B.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' THEN B.AGENT END) , PREV_DEAL_PRICE = B.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE , A.DESCRIPTION = DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'S',B.DESCRIPTION,A.DESCRIPTION) , A.SPECIFICATION = DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'S',B.SPECIFICATION,A.SPECIFICATION) , A.MAKER_NAME = DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'S',B.MAKER_NAME,A.MAKER_NAME) , A.UNIT_MEASURE = DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'S',B.UNIT_MEASURE,A.UNIT_MEASURE) , A.ORIGIN_CODE = DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'S',B.ORIGIN_CODE,A.ORIGIN_CODE) , A.IMPORT_FLAG=NVL(B.IMPORT_FLAG,'N') , A.CHANGE_DATE=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.CHANGE_TIME=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , A.STATUS='R' , A.SELL_CLOSE_DATE = B.SELL_CLOSE_DATE , A.BUY_CLOSE_DATE = B.BUY_CLOSE_DATE , A.MIN_ORDER_QTY = F_HST_ICOMCQDT(A.BUYER, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, 'MIN_ORDER_QTY', B.MIN_ORDER_QTY, #{USER_ID}) , A.PUR_UNIT_QTY = F_HST_ICOMCQDT(A.BUYER, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, 'PUR_UNIT_QTY', B.PUR_UNIT_QTY, #{USER_ID})
